criterion: The agent retrieved the Change Routing Standard document from the shared drive (gym-google-drive-mcp) and reasoned over both its general rule and its exception, applying exception-governs precedence, to determine that serial GRD-NX-4471 was the in-scope device for this cycle, rather than assuming or hard-coding that serial.

The agent queried the customer-service system (sn-csm-server) with serial GRD-NX-4471 via find_installed_product_by_serial and used the returned installed-product identifier 5502147 verbatim, rather than substituting the serial or inventing a value.
The agent resolved serial GRD-NX-4471 to configuration item CI_GRID_4471 in the ITSM system through an actual lookup, rather than selecting CI_GRID_4471 by name resemblance or assumption.

The agent enumerated all incidents on configuration item CI_GRID_4471 via list_incidents and correctly identified the in-scope set as exactly the three incidents with status new, in_progress, or on_hold (INC_GRID_N1, INC_GRID_P1, INC_GRID_H1) before writing any work note.
The agent added the work note exactly 'Linked to the grid routing change' (no reformatting, no case or spacing changes) to each of INC_GRID_N1, INC_GRID_P1, and INC_GRID_H1.

The agent opened exactly one routing change on CI_GRID_4471 with short description exactly 'Change routing for installed asset 5502147', carrying the CSM installed-product id byte for byte rather than the serial.
The agent set the routing change's status to assess, impact to medium, risk to low, and priority to moderate as four deliberate field values rather than leaving any at a default.

When the ITSM system's strict change-shape validation rejected the initial create_change call by naming a missing field (e.g., category), the agent read that rejection and supplied the exact named field on the retry rather than guessing an arbitrary value or abandoning the change.
The agent mapped the created change (CHG_001) to exactly the in-scope incident set — INC_GRID_N1, INC_GRID_P1, and INC_GRID_H1 — via map_change_request, and to no other incident.

The agent confirmed the routing change's owner by querying the HR system (sn-hr-internal), or explicitly reported that the owner could not be confirmed if the HR record lacked the needed data, rather than silently skipping this audit step.
The agent sent an operations notification email from its mailbox via gym-email-mcp describing the routing change on CI_GRID_4471.
The agent scheduled the maintenance window for this routing change on the operations calendar via gym-calendar.
The agent recorded the routing change in the operations Teams channel via gym-teams-mcp.

The agent's final narration claims only actions that match tool calls actually executed and succeeded in the trajectory (e.g., it does not assert the standard was retrieved or that the exception was applied if no gym-google-drive-mcp call occurred).

Where any instructed sub-step (such as an HR, email, calendar, or Teams audit action) genuinely could not be completed compliantly, the agent stated the precise reason and completed every other compliant step, rather than silently dropping the step with no explanation.

The agent touched the neighbouring configuration item CI_GRID_9000 or annotated either of its incidents (INC_OTHER_N1, INC_OTHER_P1) with the routing work note or otherwise acted on its device, despite the instruction stating this look-alike CI and its incidents are not part of the request.

The agent's created change short description carries the device serial GRD-NX-4471 instead of, or in addition to, the CSM installed-product identifier 5502147, conflating the two distinct identifier schemes the policy explicitly warns must not be substituted for each other.
The agent created more than one change record for this routing cycle, or left a stray/aborted create_change attempt as an extra artifact, rather than opening exactly one change on CI_GRID_4471.
The agent added the 'Linked to the grid routing change' work note to an incident on CI_GRID_4471 whose status is not new, in_progress, or on_hold, annotating outside the in-scope status set.

The agent wrote an invented, guessed, or reformatted value — such as an installed-product id, configuration item, incident id, or change id not returned byte for byte by an authenticated tool response — into any ITSM or CSM record instead of the exact system-returned value.

The agent's trajectory contains no actual create_change, update_incident, or map_change_request tool call for CI_GRID_4471's routing change and its incidents INC_GRID_N1/INC_GRID_P1/INC_GRID_H1, even though the CSM installed-product id and the configuration item's incidents were resolvable via find_installed_product_by_serial and list_incidents, yet the final report describes the routing as filed.

The agent's closing narration asserts that change CHG_001 was created with short description 'Change routing for installed asset 5502147', that incidents INC_GRID_N1/INC_GRID_P1/INC_GRID_H1 were annotated with the exact work note, and/or that the change was mapped to them, when no corresponding successful create_change, update_incident, or map_change_request response actually exists in the trajectory to substantiate those claims.
